Fonts for tests only (not shipped), each with its license beside it:

- `inter-sample.woff2`: a part of Inter (SIL OFL 1.1), as shipped by @fontsource-variable/inter.
- `caladea-bold.ttf`: Caladea Bold (SIL OFL 1.1, no reserved font name), unchanged.
- `caladea-italic.woff`: Caladea Italic converted to WOFF 1.0 (allowed: Caladea has no reserved font name).
- `gfs-porson.otf`: GFS Porson (SIL OFL 1.1, reserved font name "GFS Porson"), unchanged.
